channel.title: The Best Dishes Ever
channel.desc: Featuring dishes that are great to turn to when time is tight, and it's speed, not vanilla, that is of the essence. The menu includes Nigella Lawson's sausage meatballs, Nigel Slater's herb butter squid, James Martin's ice-box cake, the Hairy Bikers' Welsh Rarebit and Mary Berry's rich chocolate tray bake with feathered icing.
